clips.title: The story
paras: Kolkar Crag is a sunbaked, jagged gorge in southern Durotar claimed by the hostile Kolkar centaur. Led by Warlord Kolkanis, this enclave serves as a staging ground for coordinated raids against nearby Horde settlements.

Tucked away in the rugged canyons of southern Durotar, Kolkar Crag is a base of operations for the aggressive Kolkar clan. Despite the arid and unforgiving terrain, these centaur have fortified the natural choke points of the gorge. From this ravine, their scouts and marauders keep close watch over the surrounding flats, probing for vulnerabilities across orc and Darkspear holdings. For young warriors training in the Valley of Trials or patrolling the southern coast, Kolkar Crag represents the nearest organized front of centaur hostility.
